basic_info.description: Contemporary chic! Fabulous top floor 2 bed, 2 bath condo in the historic Malt House. Lovely mix of exposed concrete, bleached hardwood floors and natural light. Kitchen with stainless appliances, maple cabinetry, granite counters and breakfast bar. Open living/dining room houses a wood-burning fireplace, office nook and large windows overlooking the bldg. courtyard. Spacious master bedroom has concrete walls and built-ins and large ensuite master bathroom with shower over tub. Generous second bedroom and full bath, fantastic storage and closet space throughout, and washer dryer. Situated in the heart of North Beach, this elevator building has a central courtyard and the unit comes with private storage and 1-car garage parking.
